name: DeNA Co., Ltd.
summary: DeNA Co., Ltd. develops and operates various mobile and online services in Japan and internationally. It operates DeNA games, a free-to-play mobile apps and browser games; Mobage, an entertainment platform; Yahoo! Mobage, which offers social games for PC browsers; AndApp, a platform that allows users to play mobile game apps on PC browsers under the same user account; Pococha, a social live streaming community; and IRIAM, an app where users can live stream as an anime characters.
